gpt2_original.title: chicken bbq
steps: mix chicken, garlic, and onion in a large saucepan.
simmer for 5 minutes.
remove from heat and simmer for 1 hour.
add tomato and chicken mixture.
reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until sauce thickens.
add chicken mixture and simmer for 1 minute more.
add tomato and cook for another minute.
remove from heat.
stir in chicken mixture and simmer until chicken is tender.
serve with rice, noodles, and rice.

Chicken dinner.qwen_refined_text:
title: chicken bbj
steps:
1. combine chicken, garlic and onion in large pot over medium high heat until well browned.
2. cover and simmer for about 5 minutes on low heat.
3. drain off any excess liquid.
4. return pot to medium heat and continue simmering for 10 minutes.
5. add remaining chicken mixture and bring to a boil.
6. reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for another 10-15 minutes.
7. remove from pot and season with salt and pepper if desired.
8. pour into casserole dish lined with aluminum foil.
9. fill the bottom of the casserole with rice (or noodles) and sprinkle with additional seasoning as desired.
10.serve immediately.

gpt2_original.title: pasta with tomato
steps: heat oven to 400°f.
mix pasta with tomato.
cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes.
add basil.
cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute.
add garlic and basil.
cook, stirring often, for 1 minute more.
add remaining ingredients and cook for 1 minute more or until tomatoes are tender.
add pasta to the pasta mixture and stir to combine.
remove from heat and stir in tomatoes.
sprinkle with basil.
bake uncovered for 5 minutes.

Vegetable pasta.qwen_refined_text:
Title: pasta salad
Steps:
preheat oven to 350°F.
mix together tomato, basil, garlic and olive oil.
add pasta.
cook on medium heat for about 1 minute, turning occasionally.
remove from heat.
sprinkle with basil.
bake uncovered at 35o f for 5 min.
serve chilled.

Roasted vegetables.qwen_refined_text:
Title: potato french fries
Steps:

1. combine potato, carrot and olive oil into a large bowl until mixed well.
2. add rosemary and onion to the mixture.
3. mix thoroughly.
4. place on greased baking sheet.
5. bake at 400°f (200°C) for about 7 minutes.
6. serve hot.
